summary: Completed testing of group lessons fix. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for both Admin and Teacher views. GET /api/group-lessons/{group_id} endpoint correctly fetches lessons by group_id directly. New lessons appear immediately in listing. Teacher earning calculated correctly (only first student has teacher_rate).

Lessons filtered by group_id directly (not student_course_id) - PASS
Lessons sorted by date descending (newest first) - PASS
Teacher earning calculation correct (only first student has teacher_rate > 0) - PASS
POST /api/group-lessons creates lesson for all students in group - PASS
Free group lesson creation (admin only) - PASS
New lessons have group_id, teacher_id, branch_id, student_id fields - PASS
DELETE /api/group-lessons/{group_id}/{date} removes all lessons for date - PASS
Free lesson count calculation correct - PASS
Teacher can access own group's lessons - PASS
Admin Group Lessons page shows all lessons - PASS (UI)
Teacher Group Lessons page shows all lessons - PASS (UI)
Free lesson badge displayed correctly - PASS (UI)
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/group-lessons/{group_id} (line 4882) correctly queries lessons by group_id directly - no student_course filtering
POST /api/group-lessons (line 2179) correctly adds group_id, teacher_id, branch_id, student_id to all lesson records
Teacher earning only on first student (line 2254): lesson_teacher_rate = teacher_rate if is_first_student else 0
Both pages use raw_lessons from response for display
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test group lessons for dates 2026-04-10 and 2026-04-11 during testing. Existing group: fc279724-d0cc-4f1c-98df-3a15fbf6ce99 (5. sınıf Grup) with 27 total lessons across 14 dates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group lessons bug is FIXED. The dedicated GET /api/group-lessons/{group_id} endpoint fetches lessons directly by group_id (not via student_course_id filtering). Both Admin and Teacher pages use this endpoint. Total lessons: 27, Lesson days: 14, Free lessons: 2. Teacher earning is calculated correctly - only first student in group has teacher_rate > 0.

get_group_lessons_endpoint.details: GET /api/group-lessons/{group_id} returns group info, lessons grouped by date, total_lessons, total_dates, free_lesson_count, and raw_lessons

group_lesson_creation.details: POST /api/group-lessons creates lessons for all students in group with correct group_id, teacher_id, branch_id, student_id

teacher_earning_calculation.details: Only first student has teacher_rate > 0, others have 0 to prevent duplicate counting

lesson_visibility_in_listing.details: New lessons appear immediately in both Admin and Teacher group lesson pages

lesson_update_visibility.details: Updated lessons remain visible in listing

lesson_deletion.details: DELETE /api/group-lessons/{group_id}/{date} removes all lessons for that date

total_lesson_calculation.details: Total lessons (27) and lesson days (14) calculated correctly

admin_page.details: AdminGroupLesson.jsx shows group info, students, total lessons, lesson list with edit/delete buttons

teacher_page.details: TeacherGroupLessons.jsx shows group info, students, total lessons, lesson list with delete button, pagination
